messages:
jay_support: FYI — Acme reported a spike of 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference around 2026-03-17 14:10 UTC. Customer says node SDK enters a retry loop and many streaming requests fail with 503/504. Repro included. Need SRE + runtime triage.

ingrid_sre: On it. Can you paste the repro and any proxy/edge logs you have? Tenant id?

jay_support: Tenant: acct-ohio-124. Attaching repro snippets from customer below. Edge logs show repeated `upstream reset` and `connection refused` on reuse.

jay_support: ```bash
# curl repro (streaming)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDS_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/alpha","input":"long streaming request","stream":true}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/generate
```

jay_support: Node SDK snippet customer used:```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDS_KEY, maxConcurrency: 50, retry: { retries: 5, backoff: 200 } });
await client.generateStream({ model: 'redwood/alpha', input: largePrompt });
```

natalie_cs: Customer says errors started ~13:58 UTC. Impact: ~7% user-facing errors, some calls succeed after many retries. They want ETA and mitigation.

ingrid_sre: Quick questions: are failures tied to particular model/response lengths? Any long-lived streams? Are requests mostly multiplexed over HTTP/2?

jay_support: Yes — long responses (~5–12k tokens) and heavy multiplexing from the node SDK.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-452 created, priority P1 -> eng-runtime oncall.

bob_runtime: I pulled traces. Pattern: HTTP/2 connections in edge pool are being reused after server-side keep-alive eviction; when reused we see RST_STREAM / PROTOCOL_ERROR for multiplexed streams. SDK then retries aggressively creating a retry flood that overloads pool and causes proxy to 503/504.

bob_runtime: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) disable connection reuse for acct-ohio-124, 2) apply per-tenant concurrency cap (10), 3) widen client retry window (increase base backoff + jitter). Can apply now.

ingrid_sre: Do it. Notify CS and customer about temporary throttling.

bob_runtime: Applied at 14:28 UTC: connection reuse disabled, tenant concurrency limited -> 10, retry backoff increased to 10s with jitter for this tenant. Monitoring: error rate dropped from ~7% -> 1.1% within 8 minutes.

jay_support: Notified customer: "We've applied temporary throttling & are investigating root cause. You may see reduced throughput while we remediate. We'll update in 1 hour or earlier." :white_check_mark:

natalie_cs: Customer requests RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

bob_runtime: Root cause summary for RCA: edge keepalive eviction + HTTP/2 stream reuse bug -> RST when streams reopened; compounded by client retry behavior (no jitter + high concurrency). Fix work: patch edge proxy to reset streams before reuse, add guard for idle eviction, and coordinate SDK change to enable jitter and lower default maxConcurrency. PR #7823 opened (runtime), PR #7824 proposed (node SDK). Canary scheduled tonight. ETA 36-48h for stable rollout.

jay_support: Leaving repro steps and suggested customer guidance: set SDK maxConcurrency=8 and enable jitter/backoff until SDK patch ships.

jay_support: Suggested customer-facing blurb: "We've implemented a temporary protection to reduce failed requests and are rolling a runtime fix. Recommended client change: upgrade SDK once we notify, or set maxConcurrency=8 and enable jitter. Thanks for patience."

bob_runtime: Also adding metric alerts: per-tenant 5xx > 2% will auto-trigger throttle. Deploy patch in canary at 22:00 UTC.

jay_support: Saving logs & repro in the incident ticket. We'll follow up after canary.

ingrid_sre: Good work. Quick note for eng/runtime — please include a short changelog entry for the console and docs: "If you use streaming + high concurrency, set maxConcurrency and enable jitter."

bob_runtime: Will do. PR description includes docs + SDK recommendation.

natalie_cs: Customer replied: "Thanks — reduced errors observed. We'll wait for the update. Please notify once patch is live."

jay_support: Noted. I'll post an update after canary. :spiral_calendar:
